high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "glamour_physics." The post features a poll asking viewers which lecture they would like to attend, with options for lectures by famous physicists and scientists. The poll includes six images, each representing a different individual: Einstein: A black-and-white photo of Albert Einstein, a renowned physicist known for his theory of relativity. Tesla: A black-and-white photo of Nikola Tesla, an inventor and electrical engineer famous for his contributions to the development of alternating current (AC) electricity.
